version_policy: Major/minor technology lines are pinned here. Exact patch/transitive resolutions belong to approved lockfiles; no arbitrary patch is asserted by this scaffold.

lines.admin: React 19.x + TypeScript 5.x + Vite 7.x + React Router 7.x + TanStack Query 5.x
lines.db_access: SQLAlchemy 2.0.x + Psycopg 3.3.x; raw SQL remains DOC-08 authority
lines.python_deps: uv + PEP 621; uv.lock is Python dependency authority
lines.security: argon2-cffi + PyOTP + stdlib/cryptography; security state separate from DOC-18 Redis
lines.observability: OpenTelemetry Python + structured JSON logging + prometheus-client
lines.quality: ESLint/Prettier/dependency-cruiser + Ruff/mypy/Import Linter; pytest/Playwright/axe/k6 as later suites require
